//: EAS Build profiles for Cleanway mobile. Audit finding mobile-eas-missing HIGH — without this file `eas build -p ios|android` fails and TestFlight/Play Store distribution is blocked.

build.//: `development` builds an unsigned IPA/APK for the Expo Go-equivalent dev client. Use this for VPN debugging where the Expo Go sandbox is too restrictive (Network Extension entitlement isn't available in Expo Go).
build.//preview: `preview` is the TestFlight / Play Internal Testing track — signed but distributed to a small allowlist. Auto-increment is on so internal-test builds don't collide on the same version number.
build.//production: App Store / Play Store. Auto-increments build number so a re-submit with the same semver version still passes Apple/Google validation. Same EXPO_PUBLIC_* envs as preview — the API URL doesn't change between TestFlight and the real store. Supabase anon keys are public-by-design (gated server-side by RLS); if a secret-flavoured value is added later, move it to EAS Secrets and reference via $EAS_SECRET_NAME.

//captcha: EXPO_PUBLIC_CAPTCHA_URL (preview + production) is the hosted Turnstile challenge page. Since 1.0.5 it is used ON DEMAND only (src/utils/otp-request.ts): the code request goes out without a token, and only if Supabase answers captcha_failed does the app open this page and resend with the token. So while Supabase captcha protection is off nothing changes for anyone - no browser hop, same request bytes - and the day it is switched on (after 1.0.5 adoption, see docs/MOBILE_AUTH.md) every 1.0.5+ build already copes. The page needs NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY set on Vercel. Remove the line to build without captcha support (then a captcha_failed answer shows update-the-app).
//ios: iOS builds are always the App Store build (EXPO_PUBLIC_DISTRIBUTION is ignored on iOS). In-app purchase needs EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY (public appl_ key) as an EAS environment variable; without it (or with a wrong key) the build shows no paid plans at all — no Plan/Upgrade row, no paywall, no prices — and sets no daily check limit (src/utils/store-billing.ts paidPlansOffered). Build recipe, entitlements, App Store Connect checklist: docs/IOS.md.
//supabase: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY must exist as an EAS environment variable (Expo dashboard -> project -> Environment variables) or the build ships with sign-in dead. Local gradle builds read it from the git-ignored mobile/.env instead. See docs/MOBILE_AUTH.md.
